summary: Frontend-only test of 'Zobrazit celou fotku' (show full photo) on PDP. All requested checks passed: button visible bottom-left on photo product melosi-8841 (CZ 'Zobrazit celou fotku', VI 'Xem toàn bộ ảnh'); click opens dialog.lightbox[data-testid=full-photo-dialog] with full image (object-fit: contain, 1600x1200 natural shown uncropped); closes via close button, clicking image/backdrop, and Esc. Illustrated products (kalhotky-luna, daisy-3ks, kalhotky-aurora, podprsenka-aurora) have no button. Desktop hover zoom still works. Mobile 390x844 with real touch context: tapping the button opens dialog without triggering tap-zoom on the media; tapping photo itself still toggles zoom. No page JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: on desktop, hovering the full-photo button still zooms the underlying photo (button lives inside [data-zoom] box) - acceptable, cosmetic only.
Minor: lightbox img has empty alt; could use product name for accessibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plain JS site in frontend/public. Full-photo lightbox in app.js ~line 520 (capture-phase click handler with stopPropagation prevents tap-zoom). Photo product: #/produkt/melosi-8841.
